title: Cardiac Arrest
immediate_warning: Call emergency services immediately. Begin CPR right now.

immediate_warning_translations.en: Call emergency services immediately. Begin CPR right now.
immediate_warning_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services immediately. Begin CPR right now.
immediate_warning_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services immediately. Begin CPR right now.
immediate_warning_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services immediately. Begin CPR right now.
immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call emergency services immediately. Begin CPR right now.

description: Cardiac arrest occurs when the heart suddenly stops pumping blood. Without immediate CPR, death can occur within minutes.

description_translations.en: Cardiac arrest occurs when the heart suddenly stops pumping blood. Without immediate CPR, death can occur within minutes.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cardiac arrest occurs when the heart suddenly stops pumping blood. Without immediate CPR, death can occur within minutes.
description_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cardiac arrest occurs when the heart suddenly stops pumping blood. Without immediate CPR, death can occur within minutes.
description_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cardiac arrest occurs when the heart suddenly stops pumping blood. Without immediate CPR, death can occur within minutes.
description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cardiac arrest occurs when the heart suddenly stops pumping blood. Without immediate CPR, death can occur within minutes.

steps.instruction: Check for responsiveness — tap shoulder, shout "Are you okay?"

instruction_translations.en: Check for responsiveness — tap shoulder, shout "Are you okay?"
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for responsiveness — tap shoulder, shout "Are you okay?"
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for responsiveness — tap shoulder, shout "Are you okay?"
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for responsiveness — tap shoulder, shout "Are you okay?"
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for responsiveness — tap shoulder, shout "Are you okay?"

steps.instruction: Begin chest compressions: place heel of hand on centre of chest, push down hard and fast — 100–120 per minute.

instruction_translations.en: Begin chest compressions: place heel of hand on centre of chest, push down hard and fast — 100–120 per minute.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Begin chest compressions: place heel of hand on centre of chest, push down hard and fast — 100–120 per minute.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Begin chest compressions: place heel of hand on centre of chest, push down hard and fast — 100–120 per minute.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Begin chest compressions: place heel of hand on centre of chest, push down hard and fast — 100–120 per minute.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Begin chest compressions: place heel of hand on centre of chest, push down hard and fast — 100–120 per minute.

steps.instruction: After 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths (tilt head back, lift chin, seal mouth, blow in).

instruction_translations.en: After 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths (tilt head back, lift chin, seal mouth, blow in).
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] After 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths (tilt head back, lift chin, seal mouth, blow in).
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] After 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths (tilt head back, lift chin, seal mouth, blow in).
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] After 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths (tilt head back, lift chin, seal mouth, blow in).
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] After 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths (tilt head back, lift chin, seal mouth, blow in).

steps.instruction: Continue 30:2 cycle until emergency services arrive or person recovers.

instruction_translations.en: Continue 30:2 cycle until emergency services arrive or person recovers.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Continue 30:2 cycle until emergency services arrive or person recovers.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Continue 30:2 cycle until emergency services arrive or person recovers.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Continue 30:2 cycle until emergency services arrive or person recovers.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Continue 30:2 cycle until emergency services arrive or person recovers.

steps.instruction: Use an AED if available — turn it on and follow the voice instructions.

instruction_translations.en: Use an AED if available — turn it on and follow the voice instructions.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Use an AED if available — turn it on and follow the voice instructions.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Use an AED if available — turn it on and follow the voice instructions.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Use an AED if available — turn it on and follow the voice instructions.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Use an AED if available — turn it on and follow the voice instructions.

do_not: Do not leave the person unattended.
Do not stop CPR until help arrives.
